description: FREE (key, Set up) — what you need before you set something up. Without list_id: whether this connection may set up, the column kinds and the limits. With list_id: the list's columns (kinds), statuses, rules (triggers), the fields a condition may use with their operators, the pipelines you may hand records to, and the HubSpot accounts. Call it before add_column or create_trigger.

language.description: Language of `tell_your_user` and of Yes/No words in new columns (default en)

list_id.description: The list's id (describe_list shows the lists shared with you)

name: describe_setup
title: Describe the setup
